Cycling Peeps Saturday Spin

Albuquerque, NM · Road

Cycling Peeps Saturday Spin is a road group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls every Saturday at 7:15 am from Shown to members on the Meetup event.

For visitors

A women's group, welcoming all women 18 and older. Some rides are co-ed and say so in the title. Join the Meetup group (free) to see the start place. Helmets are required and no headphones. Donations are accepted.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:15 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate-speed road ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cycling Peeps Saturday Spin group ride

Cycling Peeps is a recreational women's cycling group in Albuquerque. Its Saturday Spin is the moderate-speed road ride, and some Saturdays are co-ed. Times change by week, so check the Meetup event. The group also runs a Wednesday morning ride.
